notes.title: Patch Notes - 10th July 2024
notes.content:
General fixes

 Fixed audio channels so that lowering the volume will actually lower the volume
 Fixed resolution and window settings
 Verified every item name to match their real item name
 Player can't move during cinematics (sorry speedrunners) 
 Player can now use keyboard arrows to move
 Added persistence to some of the tutorials that kept on repeating
 Minor spelling fix
 Zombie will now successfully kill you if seen going inside a closet


Dracula's Zone

 Fixed some dialogues that were going out of their assigned box
 Player can now talk with Clara
 The box can be climbed from both ways now
 Fixed some aim points causing trouble


Frankenstein's zone

 Ms Frankenstein now knows that a door can't be crossed magically
 Mr Frankenstein now knows how to get unstuck in case it's needed
 Mr Frankenstein can't no longer cross a supposedly tangible table
 Changed visibility on some visible collisions
 Changed second puzzle to promote understanding


Medusa's zone

 Can't no longer take items you aren't supposed to outside the trophy room
